blind.description: A stylized wooden church pew bench. It features tall, panelled end-caps with decorative capped tops, a flat wooden bench seat, a panelled backrest divided into vertical recessed panels by subtle mullions, and a low structural footrest/crossbar runner along the bottom front. The back (seen in tile D) is completely flat and plain with the back panels exposed. Surfaces are clean, solid, continuous, and stylized hand-painted low-poly wood with brown tones and subtle edge highlights. No floating or broken geometry, no melted parts, and it rests flat directly on the floor via the base of its side supports.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a narrow rectangular brown wooden bench structure with slightly wider protruding rectangular post caps at the left and right ends, showing the top rail and the horizontal seat plank.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3 ft tall) and slightly longer/wider than the figure is tall (around 6 to 7 ft wide).
